style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: EMPEROR PENGUIN family on Antarctic sea ice: two black-white adults with subtle golden neck patches and gray fluffy chick nestled between them. Accurate short black feet and flipper wings, blue glacier and ocean behind, warm low sunlight, affectionate natural animal behavior. No hats, scarves, trees, polar bears, or human faces.

Wide Antarctica habitat: small emperor penguin colony on coastal sea ice foreground-left, massive blue-white ICEBERG floating in dark cold ocean right, snow-covered rocky mountains far background. Sense of immense treeless cold landscape. Penguins correct black white gold coloration, no polar bears, no forest.

Intimate family portrait: fluffy GRAY emperor penguin chick center foreground, two much taller emperor adults left and right leaning gently toward chick, close together on sea ice. Black beaks, dark backs, white bellies, small gold neck patches on adults; chick gray down and black-white head. No clothing or human-like hands.

Close low-angle view male emperor penguin's lower body: single pale oval EGG resting ON TOP of his two broad black feet, upper egg tucked under soft lower belly brood fold for warmth. Whole papa partly visible with face above; few snowflakes in air to side. Egg NOT on bare ice, no nest, no trees.

Hatching intimate closeup: tiny fluffy gray emperor chick emerging from a cracked cream eggshell protected between adult's black feet beneath lower belly fold. One adult parent bends beak down to look, other parent softly visible behind. Pale broken shell pieces beside chick supported on feet, no egg laid on exposed ice, no hands, no nest.

Underwater emperor penguin swimming horizontally right, streamlined black back and white underside, both flippers swept like wings, feet trailing. Small silver fish school ahead right, trail of small bubbles behind left, ice ceiling far above with dim blue sunlight. No gills on penguin, no mammal flippers or human clothing.

Emperor penguin belly-sliding down a gentle snowy Antarctic slope diagonally from upper-left toward lower-right, belly in contact with snow, flippers out and black feet trailing. Soft snow spray and shallow sliding trail. Treeless snowy ice hills behind, NOT forest, no trees of any kind, no polar bears. Focus penguin and snow hill only; old tree hotspot is factually invalid and must not appear.

Close-up side of emperor penguin torso: dense overlapping black waterproof feathers with round clear water droplets beading on surface, white belly edge and gold neck visible. Cold snow at bottom and blue iceberg soft-focus background right. Natural feather texture, no fish scales, no fur, no diagram arrows.

Long waddling line of emperor penguins traveling across snow left-to-right into distance, clear paired webbed-foot footprints behind foreground birds, snowy Antarctic mountains background. Heads upright, flippers close to sides, feet on ground; no hopping flight, no forest or buildings.

Antarctic night: sweeping natural GREEN and violet aurora curtains across navy starry upper sky. Small emperor penguin family on ice in lower-left looking upward, blue iceberg in ocean lower-right. Aurora light subtle, quiet awe, no daytime sun, no trees or polar bears.

Ocean-protection concept: supervised child and adult collect safe plastic litter on a shore foreground-left using reusable bag; healthy penguin with another penguin near water at right kept clearly separate, child does NOT touch, chase or feed wildlife. A small red heart-shaped patch on collection bag visible as care symbol. Antarctic-themed conservation illustration, no tropical plants or trees, no polar bears.

Recap natural tableau on snow: emperor penguin adult at left, its pale egg visibly balanced on feet, gray chick beside at center. Distant penguins swimming near sea ice right, soft aurora high in dusk sky. Adult, egg and aurora distinct clear targets, no scattered labels, no arrows, no multiple seasons panel, no trees.
